content.short: RhinoFi is a fast stablecoin liquidity layer providing instant, scalable cross-chain liquidity via a single API.
content.description: RhinoFi delivers a fast, reliable stablecoin liquidity layer that enables instant, scalable cross‑chain liquidity through a single API. Its architecture blends an internal solver with a pre‑funded liquidity network to guarantee stablecoin pricing, minimize slippage, and deliver near‑instant settlement across 35+ chains. Trusted by more than 2 million users and supporting roughly $5.5B bridged, it covers both major and local stablecoins while incorporating KYT and single‑KYB onboarding.
